policy.name: dep-tip1 walk (lean-recovery DR)
policy.notes: dep-vref1-r1 + 2M steps of tipped-start DR: 30% of training episodes spawn already leaned 6-18 deg and the policy is paid to level out. Hardware 08-10/11: 3 clean walks, 1 runaway — better than the parent and it keeps all six legs cycling under lean instead of sacrificing one, but it is NOT immune to the roll ramp. Implication: the current best pick for driving at 0.05 m/s; walks in a low shuffle (commanded posture, known and cosmetic).
